description: A small helper that pulls the reply text out of an OpenAI-style response while tolerating several response shapes.

steps.description: `extractOpenAIText` takes the parsed response object. The page says it tolerates a few response shapes instead of crashing on an unexpected one.
First it checks for a top-level `output_text` string and returns it when present.
Otherwise it reads `choices[0].message` and returns `message.content` when that is a string.
When `message.content` is an array, it maps each part to its `text` or `content` and joins them.
If none of the shapes matched, return an empty string rather than throwing.

title: extractOpenAIText Helper
